regen_clamp.note: The chopper switches the full bus voltage across the 1 Ω dump, so its instantaneous current is bus V / 1 Ω, inside the 80 A / 3 s peak. The cycle-averaged current is compared with the 40 A heatspreader rating. Whether that rating is an average or an instantaneous limit, and the chopper ripple, are verification items.

reverse_blocking.note: Blocks during every regenerative event, not only at faults: the bus sits at the 54.4 V dump level in normal use.

bank_protection.note: Bank short-circuit current is set by cell ESR, so the aged bank gives the lowest clearing multiple. Fuse time-current behaviour at that multiple must be checked against the cell and wiring I²t.

precharge_discharge.note: The resistor limits supply current itself, so start-up does not depend on the supply overload mode. The same resistor discharges the bank for service. Pulse-energy rating, not continuous power, sizes it.

balancing.note: Cells balanced at the setpoint; dynamic excursions above it divide by capacitance, so the lowest-capacitance cell rises fastest. Leakage-driven drift is held by the passive resistors while the supply holds the setpoint.

dump_monitor.rule: Expected dump current is commanded duty × bus V / 1 Ω. Flag a dump-path fault when measured current stays below half of expected for 0.1 s while expected exceeds 2 A, or when the bus exceeds 54.5 V (full duty) for 0.1 s; stop the unit and latch, independent of the overvoltage trip.

bank_duty.rule: Bank temperature sensing (balancing node) feeds the existing torque derate from 55 °C to the case maximum; this is the duty limit for back-to-back fast work.
